# Overview

The current operations at VONQ involve several key internal teams, notably Finance, commercial/CRM, data/analytics, and senior leadership, all of whom play active roles in exit preparation and investor reporting. These teams utilize a range of systems and data sources, including a Finance System, CRM, ERP, and the Qlik Warehouse, which also serves as the central data and reporting platform. Additional Excel-based datasets and external systems may be brought in depending on feasibility and mutual agreement.

For reporting and analytics, VONQ relies primarily on Qlik-based reporting tools connected to the Qlik Warehouse. The primary data sources are the Finance System, CRM, and ERP, with legacy sources required for compiling at least three years of trended data to support reporting requirements. While the Qlik Warehouse functions as the main cloud data infrastructure, some source systems currently lack automated integration and require manual, one-off ingestion into the platform. Where ongoing data refreshes are required during the transaction process, a formal refresh process is in place or will be established.
